CVE-2026-125400.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a use-after-free vulnerability i ...
CVE-2026-125400.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in func_pcre() in src/ec_filter.c that reads the PCRE2 ovector after freeing match data. Network-adjacent attackers can send packets matching a loaded pcre_regex() substitution filter to corrupt memory and potentially execute code as root.

CVE-2026-125401.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerabi ...
CVE-2026-125401.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in gg_get_version() in src/dissectors/ec_gg.c that writes up to 44 bytes into a 30-byte allocation. Remote attackers can send Gadu-Gadu traffic on TCP port 8074 with a crafted version field through a monitored network to corrupt heap memory in the Ettercap process, which normally runs as root.

CVE-2026-125402.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulner ...
CVE-2026-125402.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in sslw_get_clienthello_sni() in src/ec_sslwrap.c that trusts the unchecked 16-bit SNI length field. Network-adjacent attackers can send crafted TLS ClientHello messages during SSL interception to leak up to 64 KB of heap memory upstream or crash Ettercap.

CVE-2026-125403.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains an out-of-bounds read and size_t ...
CVE-2026-125403.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains an out-of-bounds read and size_t underflow vulnerability in sslw_remove_sts() in src/ec_sslwrap.c, caused by a stale length and an unchecked memmem() result when stripping Strict-Transport-Security headers. A malicious HTTPS server whose response passes through Ettercap's SSL interception can trigger out-of-bounds reads and memory corruption in the Ettercap process, which normally runs as root.

CVE-2026-125404.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains an integer underflow in ccmp_dec ...
CVE-2026-125404.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains an integer underflow in ccmp_decrypt() in src/ec_encryption_ccmp.c that subtracts the 8-byte CCMP trailer without checking minimum length. Attackers on a network whose WPA key is loaded can send a short crafted CCMP frame to overflow a stack buffer in the Ettercap process, which normally runs as root.

CVE-2026-125405.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerabil ...
CVE-2026-125405.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Parse_NTLM_Auth() in src/dissectors/ec_http.c due to unvalidated NTLM message offsets. Attackers can send a crafted HTTP Authorization header observed by Ettercap to read beyond the buffer, disclosing memory or crashing the process.

CVE-2026-125406.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a stack buffer underwrite vulner ...
CVE-2026-125406.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.1 contains a stack buffer underwrite vulnerability in the telnet dissector in src/dissectors/ec_telnet.c that decrements the output pointer on backspace without a lower bound check. Attackers can send a telnet stream with more backspaces than preceding characters to write below the stack buffer, corrupting the stack of the Ettercap process that normally runs as root.

CVE-2026-129431.title: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulne ...
CVE-2026-129431.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_socks() in src/dissectors/ec_socks.c that allows network-adjacent attackers to read heap memory via unchecked SOCKS5 username/password lengths. Attackers can send a crafted SOCKS5 authentication packet observed by Ettercap to read up to 255 bytes past the heap buffer, disclosing memory printed and logged as captured credentials.

CVE-2026-129432.title: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulne ...
CVE-2026-129432.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mountd() in src/dissectors/ec_mountd.c that validates RPC credential and directory lengths independently rather than against the packet end. Network-adjacent attackers can send a crafted MOUNT MNT call to read up to 100 bytes past the heap buffer, leaking memory to the console and logs.

CVE-2026-131853.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulner ...
CVE-2026-131853.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_ssh() in src/dissectors/ec_ssh.c that copies a peer-supplied data_len without checking remaining packet bytes. A malicious SSHv1 client or server in an intercepted session can send a short packet with a large data_len to disclose up to 64 bytes of adjacent heap memory through captured credentials in the interface and log.

CVE-2026-131854.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulner ...
CVE-2026-131854.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

CVE-2026-131855.title: Ettercap before 0.8.5.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulner ...
CVE-2026-131855.description: Ettercap before 0.8.5.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes. A malicious VNC server can send the authentication type and challenge in one short packet to leak up to 3 bytes of adjacent heap memory via the logged challenge.
